subtopics.title: Origins and Core Objectives
subtopics.summary: The Quad grew out of humanitarian cooperation after the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami and its concept was championed by Shinzo Abe in 2007. The grouping was revitalised in 2017 amid concerns over China's expanding military and economic influence. It remains an informal strategic partnership of India, the United States, Japan and Australia.
facts: Quad foundations emerged through humanitarian cooperation after the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami.
The Quad concept was championed by former Japanese PM Shinzo Abe in 2007.
The grouping was revitalised in 2017 amid concerns over China's expanding military and economic influence.
Quad stands for Quadrilateral Security Dialogue.
Members: India, United States, Japan and Australia.
It is an informal strategic partnership, enabling cooperation without a formal military alliance.
Core objective: a Free, Open, Inclusive, Secure and Prosperous Indo-Pacific.
Principles: rule of law, freedom of navigation, territorial integrity, peaceful resolution of disputes.

subtopics.title: Maritime and Security Cooperation
subtopics.summary: Maritime cooperation is the most visible strand of the 11th meeting's outcomes. The outcomes include a surveillance framework that uses tracking assets of all members and a partnership for near real-time maritime data. Security work also covers the Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission, the Malabar Exercise and a counterterrorism tabletop exercise.
facts: Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration uses tracking and monitoring assets of all Quad members.
Immediate focus area of maritime surveillance: the Indian Ocean Region.
Maritime surveillance objective: strengthen maritime domain awareness and monitor illicit maritime activities.
Indo-Pacific Partnership for Maritime Domain Awareness enables near real-time maritime data sharing across regional waters.
Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission was launched under the Wilmington Declaration.
Quad-at-Sea objective: improve naval coordination, enhance interoperability, counter illegal maritime activities.
India will host the next edition of the Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission.
Malabar Exercise is an annual multilateral naval exercise of Quad members.
Quad Counterterrorism Tabletop Exercise focuses on state-sponsored terrorism, UAV threats and joint crisis response planning; to be hosted by Australia in 2026.

subtopics.title: Economic Security and Emerging Technologies
subtopics.summary: The Quad's economic agenda centres on critical minerals, energy security and supply-chain resilience. Its infrastructure and technology work covers Pacific island connectivity, digital identity interoperability and AI-driven agriculture. Several initiatives aim to diversify sources beyond dominant suppliers.
facts: Quad Critical Minerals Initiative Framework coordinates investments and policies on mining, processing and recycling of critical minerals.
Critical minerals significance: reduce supply-chain vulnerabilities and diversify sources beyond dominant suppliers.
Indo-Pacific Energy Security Initiative launched a Joint Regional Energy Roadmap with commitment of over USD 25 million.
Energy focus areas: energy technology integration, supply chain resilience and market risk assessment.
Pacific Island Infrastructure Outreach is a collaboration with Fiji.
Outreach goals: connect all Pacific Island Forum countries through resilient undersea cable networks and modernise port infrastructure.
Outreach target: completion by 2026.
Digital Identity Interoperability involves developing a technical 'Translation Guide' for digital identity systems.
AI-ENGAGE Initiative aims to enhance agricultural productivity and food security across the Indo-Pacific.

subtopics.title: Significance for India and the Global Order
subtopics.summary: The Quad is presented as a strategic counterbalance that opposes unilateral attempts to alter the status quo. For India, it helps balance China's growing maritime presence, improve monitoring of maritime activity and attract investment. Its technology and supply-chain work also supports diversification under the China+1 strategy.
facts: Strategic counterbalance: supports freedom of navigation and opposes unilateral attempts to alter the status quo.
Supply-chain resilience supports diversification under the China+1 strategy.
Technology cooperation covers AI, cybersecurity, 5G/6G, Open RAN networks and secure digital infrastructure.
Quad provides regional public goods: disaster relief, health security, infrastructure support and capacity building.
For India, the Quad balances China's growing maritime presence and String of Pearls strategy in the Indian Ocean.
For India, the Quad preserves strategic autonomy without entering a formal military alliance.
For India, the Quad enhances monitoring of maritime activities and detection of illegal fishing and grey-zone tactics.
Blue Dot Network and the Supply Chain Resilience Initiative helped India attract foreign investment and integrate into global value chains.

quizzes.title: Quad at a glance: MCQ set
quizzes.passage:
The Quad is a grouping of India, the United States, Japan and Australia that has grown from a set of humanitarian contacts into a regular diplomatic forum. Its roots lie in cooperation that followed a devastating disaster in the Indian Ocean region. A Japanese leader later gave the idea a sharper political shape, and the grouping was revitalised in response to growing unease about the expanding military and economic presence of a large regional power in the Indo-Pacific.

Today the Quad works as an informal strategic partnership rather than a formal alliance. Its stated aim is a region that is free, open, inclusive, secure and prosperous, anchored in the rule of law, freedom of navigation, territorial integrity and the peaceful resolution of disputes.

The eleventh foreign ministers' meeting of the group turned these ideas into concrete outcomes across several areas. Maritime cooperation is the most visible strand, with shared surveillance tools and data arrangements focused initially on the Indian Ocean. Other outcomes cover critical minerals, energy, undersea connectivity, digital identity systems and agriculture. Many of these efforts aim to reduce dependence on a few suppliers and to build resilient supply chains and infrastructure across the region.

Consider the following statements about Quad initiatives:
I. The Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission was launched under the Wilmington Declaration.
II. The Indo-Pacific Energy Security Initiative includes a Joint Regional Energy Roadmap with a commitment of over USD 25 million.
III. The Quad Counterterrorism Tabletop Exercise in 2026 is to be hosted by India.

questions.explanation: Statement III is wrong because the 2026 counterterrorism exercise is to be hosted by Australia.

questions.q:
How many of the following statements about the Quad are correct?
I. The Quad stands for Quadrilateral Security Dialogue.
II. South Korea is a full member of the Quad.
III. India will host the next edition of the Quad-at-Sea Ship Observer Mission.
IV. The Quad Counterterrorism Tabletop Exercise is to be hosted by Japan in 2026.
questions.explanation: Statements I and III are correct, while South Korea is only a Quad Plus participant and the 2026 exercise is hosted by Australia.

quizzes.title: Economy and technology: typed answers
quizzes.passage:
Economic security has become a central part of the Quad's agenda. Members have recognised that depending on a small number of suppliers for essential raw materials can disrupt entire industries, so they are working to spread sources more widely. Cooperation now spans the full life cycle of key minerals, from mining and processing to recycling, with the aim of making supply less exposed to shocks.

Energy is another priority. The group has agreed to a joint regional approach that links energy technology, supply chain strength and the assessment of market risks. This work is meant to help countries across the Indo-Pacific cope with uncertainty in fuel and power markets.

The Pacific islands are also part of the agenda. A planned outreach effort aims to link island nations of the Pacific Islands Forum through a more robust network and to modernise ports, with completion targeted for the near term.

On technology, the Quad is developing practical tools for digital systems. Officials are preparing a reference document that will help public and private platforms work with one another across borders. A separate initiative uses artificial intelligence, robotics and remote sensing to support farming and food security. Together these efforts seek to make growth in the region both secure and resilient.

questions.q: Along with the Supply Chain Resilience Initiative, which network is credited with helping India attract foreign investment?
questions.explanation: The booklet says the Blue Dot Network and the Supply Chain Resilience Initiative benefited India in attracting foreign investment.

questions.q: Which Quad framework coordinates investments and policies on mining, processing and recycling of critical minerals? (Give the framework's name.)
questions.explanation: The Quad Critical Minerals Initiative Framework coordinates investments and policies relating to mining, processing and recycling of critical minerals.
